Subject: Final post-incident summary and retention notes

Amelia — attaching the post-incident document now that we've completed the internal review and validation. Key points:
- Root cause: a misrouted auth token refresh path during a rolling infra deployment; no credentials were exposed; impact limited to session regeneration for ~0.2% of active sessions during a 14-minute window.
- Detection & containment: automated anomaly trigger -> ephemeral key rotation -> client session invalidation; containment completed within 18 minutes of detection.
- Remediation: configuration guard added to deployment orchestration; additional unit tests and a pre-deploy validation step scheduled.
- Evidence provided: sanitized auth-event CSV (hashes only), runbook excerpt, and timeline.

Retention & use: Redwood requests that artifacts remain accessible to ClearLine for 90 days from delivery for compliance validation and that any redistributed materials mask account identifiers beyond the provided pseudonyms. If ClearLine requires longer access we can open a DTA to define retention controls.

Attachments: [Attachment: postmortem_clearline_20260115.pdf (PDF, 680KB)]; [Attachment: sanitized_telemetry_20260115.csv (CSV, 240KB)]

If your team wants a short walkthrough call, we're available tomorrow morning PST.

Regards,
